independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored neither round-6 repair: T-DG1-BE7 (module lint, F-DG1-125) and the F-DG1-126 installer copy-back change (3037ce2). It authored none of the reviewed product implementation. Before earlier freezes, qa-verifier authored the acceptance suites under tests/qa/** and e2e/** (A12, A13, A14, A18, A20); these are test code, not product code. Nothing was added to the candidate this round. My two new probes are stored under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/ (candidate-excluded). I formed this verdict before reading any other round-6 reviewer record, and I read none. During my run, HEAD moved from f03a9fa to 1f680fa through two run-agent.sh auto-commits of the domain and code-security reviewers' records. I looked only at `git diff --stat` file names, recomputed the candidate ID (unchanged, matches=true) and did not open those records or their evidence.

checks_run.expected: assignment sha256 3942dd3a...; candidate ID sha256:a7b46fbc...210d at HEAD and at 0026a7b; commits after the freeze touch only candidate-excluded metadata
checks_run.actual: Assignment sha256 matches. HEAD at start was f03a9fa, the child of the freeze commit 0026a7b. Its diff is the round-6 assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json (all excluded). Not shallow. candidate.mjs returns sha256:a7b46fbc29db6bb855495593e43f2e859305dea9d6c403fe86f73619d9fb210d (390 files) for the working tree, --diff gives matches=true with no added, removed or changed files, and --ref 0026a7b gives the same ID. HEAD later moved to 1f680fa through other reviewers' auto-committed run evidence. I re-checked: the ID is unchanged.

summary: PASS on candidate sha256:a7b46fbc...210d (commit 0026a7b). Both assigned fixes verify. F-DG1-125: the process-module import is banned, X6-X8 fail on the pre-fix testkit and pass now, a real plant turns the tree red, my 12 extra routes are all caught, and the change is test-only. F-DG1-126: copy-back uses pnpm's own members; AC-10 passes and fails on the pre-fix installer; my 5-case member probe passes, including a non-root member and out-of-root refusal. No regression: static 7/7, unit 270/270, integration 200/200 twice with no 57P01, e2e 22/22 EN+AR including F-DG1-210, A12/A13/A14/A18/A20 green, and the validators pass. One new Low, non-mandatory finding: F-DG1-212, REQ-DLV-042's cited installer log is the pre-fix 13-case run. BLOCKED, not PASS: AC-1 (effect) as written and deps:verify, both for lack of registry network.
